cited_by.title: Moringa: blood sugar, blood pressure and general health

record.population: Humans and animals (narrative safety and efficacy review)
record.n: five human studies of leaf powder
record.finding: Animal safety studies of aqueous leaf extract indicate a high degree of safety, and the authors say no adverse effects were reported in human studies. They describe the five human studies as showing anti-hyperglycaemic and anti-dyslipidaemic activity, and call for human studies with standardised extracts.
record.note: Older, narrative and more favourable than the 2025 meta-analysis; the five human studies were small.
